messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for canary rollout v2.3. p95 latency > 800ms for the last 2m, p99 > 2.5s. Streaming stalls observed in eu-west-1. Impact: some hosted API requests see streaming timeouts. Paging oncall.
alex (platform-eng): saw the alert. canary was shifted 20% to v2.3 ~08:05 UTC. starting investigation — tagging oncall.
maria (oncall-sre): oncall here. ack. pulling metrics and recent deploys. can someone paste the rollout plan? :eyes:
jonah (runtime-eng): alex started the traffic-shift from 0 -> 20% at 08:03. rollout config: canary window 10m, fallback to v2.2. KV cache warmup enabled. I’m checking kernel selection logs.
linda (product-ops): flagging a small set of customers on the canary workspace. product impact unknown yet, but support queue has 3 tickets about slow responses. kevin are you seeing more?
kevin (support): yes, 3 customers reporting streaming stalls and 'incomplete generation' errors. timestamps: ~08:06-08:10 UTC. they are on eu-west-1.
alex (platform-eng): confirming p95 jump correlates with traffic shift. p95 graph: quick spike from 230ms -> ~900ms. p99 tail to ~3s. probable regression in v2.3 attention kernel on longer contexts.
maria (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation options: (1) revert canary -> shift traffic back to v2.2 (2) isolate region eu-west-1 to v2.2 (3) increase replica count / scale up GPU type for canary pool. Which is fastest?
jonah (runtime-eng): quickest is to rollback the canary flag (route all canary traffic to v2.2). can perform a traffic patch now: 
```
# k8s rollout controller-ish command
redwood rollout patch --model v2.3 --set-traffic 0 --canary-id canary-77
```
That will route 0% to v2.3 and drain existing streams gracefully.
alex (platform-eng): I can trigger the rollback. before that i want to try a targeted routing rule: move eu-west-1 off v2.3 only, keep other regions on 20% to observe. If rollback is needed we do full revert.
maria (oncall-sre): do region isolation first. less blast radius. if stalls stop we avoid full rollback.
kevin (support): please update support playbook so we can reply to customers. suggested message: "We identified increased latency in eu-west-1 due to a canary model update; engineers are rolling back traffic for that region. We'll update when resolved."
alex (platform-eng): applying routing patch now. command:
```
redwood routing update --region eu-west-1 --model v2.2 --force-evict 1m
```
Estimated time to apply ~30s.
incident-bot: ACTION: routing change initiated by alex at 08:12:05 UTC. Job id: job-5623
maria (oncall-sre): watching metrics. pls monitor streaming success rate and p95 across regions.
jonah (runtime-eng): looking at runtime logs — saw a surge of attention kernel fallbacks and OOM-indicators on canary hosts at ~08:06. sample trace:
```
[08:06:14] host-canary-3: attention-kernel-fallback=true, kv_cache_miss=0.32, slot_alloc_fail=0
[08:06:14] host-canary-3: stream_flush_delay=1320ms
```
That would explain streaming stalls. might be quantization interaction with long-context batching.
alex (platform-eng): routing change completed. job-5623 status=success. eu-west-1 now pinned to v2.2 for user-facing traffic. (still leaving internal testing on v2.3 in staging)
maria (oncall-sre): metrics update: p95 in eu-west-1 dropping back toward 240-300ms over the last 45s. p99 trending down. streaming success rate improving from 81% -> 98%.
kevin (support): updating customers: sending the suggested message and marking as "under active investigation, mitigated for eu-west-1, global canary remains under review".
linda (product-ops): thanks. will pause any additional customer invites to canary cohort and open a postmortem page. need to note which workspaces were affected.
jonah (runtime-eng): next steps: collect heap/kernel traces from canary hosts, reproduce locally with longer context + quantized weights. don’t re-roll until root cause confirmed. i’ll capture diagnostics: 
```
redwood diag collect --hosts host-canary-* --since 08:00 --out /tmp/v2.3-trace.tar.gz
```
maria (oncall-sre): handoff: i’ll stay on for the next 30m to confirm stability; alex please coordinate rollback if any regression persists in other regions. open incident channel for postmortem.
alex (platform-eng): noted. leaving an entry in incidents tracker and creating a follow-up ticket for runtime/qa to reproduce. tags: canary, v2.3, latency, streaming-stall, eu-west-1.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: immediate customer impact mitigated by region routing at 08:12:45 UTC. Auto-close disabled; oncall to confirm full stability before close.
maria (oncall-sre): confirmed stability window 10m passed with no regression. raising followup: timeline + RCA draft. assign to jonah for root cause and to qa for regression tests.
jonah (runtime-eng): will run root cause analysis. initial hypothesis: quantized attention kernel regression under certain batch/sequence lengths causing slow kernel fallback. will post logs and repro by EOD.
linda (product-ops): notifying sales and customer success about the mitigation and expected RCA timeline. thanks team. :heart:
kevin (support): closing affected tickets as mitigated, will reopen if customers see anything else.
alex (platform-eng): final note — we should add a pre-rollout perf check for attention-kernel fallbacks in canary smoke tests. created ticket #INC-4082.
maria (oncall-sre): handing off to day oncall. i’m leaving the thread open for any late regressions. good job everyone. :clap:
